messages:
tayla: FYI a customer (ACME-682) says their Console shows 1,000 trial credits at org level but their API usage is still billing. They provided an API key used from 'acme-web' project. Can someone check mapping?

billing-ian: Can you paste acct id + a sample request header? Usually org credits auto-apply but there are edge cases with service keys.

tayla: acct: ACME-682
Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-ACME-abc123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response headers show x-credits-applied: false, billing_project_id: 987654

raj: That billing_project_id (987654) is not the customer's 'acme-web' project (12345). Likely the key was created under a service account or migrated incorrectly. Run:
```
SELECT p.id, p.name, k.key, k.created_by, k.org_credit_id
FROM projects p
JOIN api_keys k ON k.project_id = p.id
WHERE p.org_id = 'ACME-682' AND k.key LIKE 'sk-live-ACME%';
```
This will show whether key is attached to the right project and if org_credit_id is null.

tayla: Ran that, it shows key attached to project 987654 (name 'acme-service'), created_by: unknown_bot, org_credit_id: NULL

ops_jamie: There's a known migration bug where programmatic keys created via the older service-account flow lost the org_credit_id link. We shipped a fix in patch 2026-03-08 but keys created before the fix require a resync job.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3345 — billing mapping resync for ACME-682. Assigned to @ops_jamie and @raj

billing-ian: I can run a manual resync to attach org_credit_id to all keys in that org and issue a pro-rated credit for any overage in the meantime. Approving: @marco?

marco: Please go ahead. Customer is on a deadline; if resync will be >4h, issue the interim credit. :pray:

raj: For engineering repro: steps to reproduce
1) Create org with trial credits
2) Create service account via legacy API
3) Create API key for that service account
4) Make a request and inspect x-credits-applied
We saw the key's org_credit_id is null; resync will set org_credit_id -> 'trial-2026-03' and subsequent usage will be billed against credits.

tayla: I'll update customer: telling them we opened INC-2026-3345, engineering will resync keys, billing will apply a manual credit if they saw charges. ETA ~2-6 hours. Keeping this thread for notes.

billing-ian: Done — manual resync kicked off. Patch note: resync script logs at /var/log/billing/resync/ACME-682-1891234567.log

tayla: Thanks team — I'll DM ACME with the incident link and follow up once resync completes. :thumbsup:
